title: cynosurus cristatus f. pratensis
intro: Cynosurus cristatus f. pratensis, commonly known as Crested Dog's-tail or a variant of the Cynosurus cristatus, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce swelling and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Cynosurus cristatus f. pratensis include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antibacterial, and antifungal agent, making it useful in wound healing and the treatment of skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
